currently, it seems that every unknown agent event - line is put in it's own box. this clutters the ui. *consecutive unknown agent events*, should be grouped together in 1 block.

## Current state

`CodexStreamingAdapter` records unsupported item lifecycle notifications as `diagnostic` conversation events. Each has a readable line such as `item/started: futureTool (future-1)` and omits raw provider payloads.

`AgentRunnerService` appends every normalized diagnostic as a separate canonical conversation entry because each notification has a unique provider item identity. The shared conversation reader preserves those separate entries when loading persisted files.

`ActionConversationChat` correctly renders canonical entries without merging them. Separate diagnostic entries therefore produce one bordered box per line.

## implementation details

- Keep `CodexStreamingAdapter` normalization and redaction unchanged. It may emit one safe diagnostic per unsupported provider notification.
- When `AgentRunnerService` produces canonical conversation entries, coalesce a diagnostic with the immediately preceding diagnostic entry. Append its readable content after the existing content with a newline.
- Preserve the first diagnostic entry's id, provider item id, sequence, timestamp, label, type, and position. Emit the expanded entry with the same provider item id so live app state replaces it in place.
- A message or any recognized event ends the run because it becomes the conversation tail. The next diagnostic starts a new canonical entry.
- Apply the same consecutive-diagnostic coalescing in the shared conversation reader. This normalizes existing persisted files when read and must be idempotent for files that already contain grouped multiline diagnostics.
- Keep raw persisted files unchanged during reads. Newly persisted conversations contain grouped diagnostic entries produced during the run.
- Keep `ActionConversationChat` and recognized reasoning, command, tool, and system event rendering unchanged. Existing `AgentToolEvent` multiline rendering displays each diagnostic line in order.
- Add runner regression tests for live grouping, stable identity, boundaries, and ordering. Add reader regression tests for existing files, boundaries, and idempotence. Add a chat regression test for rendering one multiline diagnostic block.

## edge cases

- One diagnostic remains one canonical event.
- Consecutive diagnostics for different unsupported items still share one run.
- Messages and recognized events split runs, including recognized events hidden by current chat visibility rules.
- Reading an already grouped multiline diagnostic does not change its content.
- Grouping never reads or exposes raw provider payload fields; only normalized diagnostic content is appended.

## acceptance criteria

- Consecutive unknown-agent diagnostics are one canonical conversation event during live execution and after file loading.
- Messages and recognized events split diagnostic runs into separate canonical events.
- Grouped live updates retain the first entry's identity and position.
- Every diagnostic line remains visible in original order without exposing raw provider payloads.
- Existing persisted files are normalized on read without being rewritten.
- Single diagnostics, chat rendering, and all recognized event types retain existing content and behavior.

Layout and paint are small; synchronous React work consumes most of the time.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Cause\\r\\n\\r\\n`NewCardDialog` passes `handleBodyChange` to `MarkdownEditor.onLiveChange`. Every editor change calls `setBody`, rerendering the complete dialog and the MDXEditor subtree. This also recreates the Markdown editor plugin array and many MUI elements and style objects. Development-mode React work and garbage collection amplify the cost.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis bypasses the lifetime-stable editor approach already used by `CardEditor` and `CardBodyEditor`. `MarkdownEditor` already buffers local edits and exposes `getMarkdown`, `setMarkdown`, and `flush`; normal typing does not need to propagate the full body into parent React state.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Keep the new-card Markdown editor lifetime-stable while typing, following `CardEditor` and `CardBodyEditor`.\\r\\n- Do not store the full Markdown body in `NewCardDialog` state on every keystroke.\\r\\n- Read the current body from the editor when submitting, checking whether the draft is dirty, and inserting or clearing the template.\\r\\n- Preserve existing template behavior: untouched template can be cleared; editing it changes the action back to `Template`; inserting then appends without discarding text.\\r\\n- Keep reset, cancel confirmation, `Ctrl+Enter`, and target-column behavior unchanged.\\r\\n- Do not change shared `MarkdownEditor` buffering semantics solely for this dialog.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- [ ] Typing in the new-card description does not rerender `NewCardDialog` or remount/rerender the Markdown editor for every keystroke.\\r\\n- [ ] Submitted card body exactly matches current editor content.\\r\\n- [ ] Cancel confirmation detects description-only edits.\\r\\n- [ ] Template insert, clear, edit, and append behavior remains unchanged.\\r\\n- [ ] Opening, closing, successful creation, and project changes reset the draft correctly.\\r\\n- [ ] A regression test verifies repeated description edits do not repeatedly render the editor boundary.\\r\\n- [ ] Existing new-card dialog and Markdown editor tests pass.\\r\\n\\n===== B_82_orphaned_git_for_windows_processes.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: B_82\\r\\ninternalId: d97a054f-5a67-47bb-9070-df874cf9148e\\r\\ntitle: agent runs leave orphaned Git for Windows processes\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: 7bdf27fc-963c-4545-83e2-93410e67f0e3\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Problem\\r\\n\\r\\nAgent runs launched through MDÃ‚Â² can leave multiple `git.exe` processes running indefinitely. The processes appear as **Git for Windows** in Task Manager and accumulate across runs.\\r\\n\\r\\nObserved processes were executing normally short-lived commands such as `config`, `rev-parse`, `remote -v`, and `status --porcelain`. They remained alive after their immediate parent processes had exited.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current implementation\\r\\n\\r\\nMDÃ‚Â² starts agents through `AgentRunnerService`. When an agent closes normally, `handleClose` queries the current Windows process tree and terminates descendants of the agent PID. Cancellation terminates the process tree with `taskkill /t /f`.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis cleanup cannot discover a surviving Git process after an intermediate parent has already exited: the current process snapshot no longer contains a complete chain from the agent PID to that Git process. The observed Git processes had dead immediate parents, matching this failure mode.\\r\\n\\r\\nMDÃ‚Â² also invokes Git directly through `git_commands.js`. These calls have no timeout or cancellation handling, so an independently hung app-owned Git command can block its caller indefinitely.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Investigation plan\\r\\n\\r\\n1. Reproduce with MDÃ‚Â² open but no agent run, then while starting and completing or cancelling an agent run.\\r\\n2. Record every spawned Git PID, command, working directory, parent PID, agent run ID, and lifecycle event.\\r\\n3. Run an affected command under a bounded external timeout with Git tracing enabled to locate the blocking operation.\\r\\n4. Check repository state, Git configuration, filesystem monitoring, antivirus or file locks, and agent shutdown ordering.\\r\\n5. Confirm whether Git descendants become disconnected before `AgentRunnerService.handleClose` takes its process snapshot.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Track enough process ownership during an agent run to terminate surviving descendants even when intermediate processes exit before final cleanup.\\r\\n- Clean up owned descendants when an agent completes, fails, is cancelled, or crashes.\\r\\n- Do not terminate unrelated Git processes or Git work started outside the corresponding MDÃ‚Â² agent run.\\r\\n- Add a bounded timeout and process cleanup to direct Git execution in `git_commands.js`.\\r\\n- Include the command, working directory, elapsed time, and owning run or app operation in timeout diagnostics.\\r\\n- Deduplicate or serialize repeated read-only metadata probes only if tracing confirms they contribute to the accumulation.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Failure modes and compatibility\\r\\n\\r\\n- PID reuse must not allow cleanup to target a process that MDÃ‚Â² did not start.\\r\\n- Cleanup must cover shell and helper-process chains used by Git for Windows on Windows.\\r\\n- Long-running network Git operations need an explicit, suitable timeout rather than the same threshold as local metadata commands.\\r\\n- Existing agent cancellation, command actions, commits, worktree operations, push, pull, and fetch behavior must remain unchanged apart from bounded failure and cleanup.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- [ ] Completing, failing, cancelling, or crashing an agent run leaves no Git processes owned by that run.\\r\\n- [ ] Repeated agent runs do not accumulate Git for Windows processes.\\r\\n\\n===== B_85_add_the_reference_to_a_chatlog_to_a_card_as_soon_as_possible.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: B_85\\r\\ninternalId: 56dd54b0-9554-4545-85d4-bb45efef4d6e\\r\\ntitle: add the reference to a chatlog to a card as soon as possible\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\n  - Keep command actions unchanged.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- Selecting or reopening action with active conversation does not prefill its stored action prompt.\\r\\n- Existing user-entered draft for active conversation is restored.\\r\\n- Late prompt-preparation result cannot overwrite active conversation input.\\r\\n- Idle agent actions still prefill stored prompt.\\r\\n- Controller and popup tests cover action switching, popup reopen, draft restore, and preparation race.\\r\\n\\n===== F_95_integrate_into_project_should_track_commit.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: F_95\\r\\ninternalId: e5b95f2c-cd0c-4623-8e12-d0c497447e71\\r\\ntitle: integrate into project should track commit\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\n  - design/activity/card__e5b95f2c-cd0c-4623-8e12-d0c497447e71.json#conversation=agent-4e6f97b9-647e-49fc-93f7-cf09e5eff1aa\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: 9ef42f8e-d6f7-4514-8e4a-5555318c4b51\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current state\\r\\n\\r\\n`WorktreeSelector` integrates an assigned card through `WorktreeService` and the Electron worktree service. Typing, flushing, preparing, replacing, clearing, restoring, and remotely synchronizing a prompt must not place the prompt text or reset counters in `ActionPopupContent` or its controller React state.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis job must land before the major action-popup ownership and subscription refactor.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current architecture\\r\\n\\r\\nPrompt ownership is duplicated:\\r\\n\\r\\n- `useActionPopupController` stores prompt value, preparation status, and reset token in React state.\\r\\n- `ActionPopupContent` creates a new `ActionPromptDraft` whenever the controller prompt or reset token changes.\\r\\n- `ActionPromptDraft` buffers live editor values and supports a narrow bottom-row subscription.\\r\\n- `ActionExecutionService` separately stores prompt values, revisions, pending bridge writes, and remote prompt sessions.\\r\\n\\r\\nOrdinary typing already stays out of root React state because `MarkdownEditor.onLiveChange` writes to `ActionPromptDraft`. Editor flush still calls `setPromptState`, and external preparation/replacement/clear operations update root state and replace the draft object. Those paths rerender the complete popup.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required ownership\\r\\n\\r\\nCreate one prompt-draft service that owns stable draft stores keyed by the action context and, when applicable, the active agent session. The service is justified because it owns state, draft lifecycle, asynchronous bridge synchronization, revisions, and pending writes.\\r\\n\\r\\nMove the current prompt-draft map and remote prompt-session behavior out of `ActionExecutionService`. The renamed run/session service planned by the later popup refactor must not retain prompt text ownership.\\r\\n\\r\\nEach stable draft store exposes, at minimum:\\r\\n\\r\\n- current Markdown value;\\r\\n- preparation state: `loading`, `ready`, or `failed`;\\r\\n- a narrow subscription contract suitable for `useSyncExternalStore`;\\r\\n- local edit without React parent state;\\r\\n- external replacement that notifies the editor to call `setMarkdown` once;\\r\\n- clear, flush/synchronize, send, and current-value reads;\\r\\n- revision protection for superseded asynchronous preparation and remote writes.\\r\\n\\r\\nDo not add arbitrary retention limits or silent eviction. Draft removal must follow explicit lifecycle events such as successful send, deliberate clear, action removal, or project teardown. A popup unmount does not discard an unsent draft.\\r\\n\\r\\n\\n===== J_023_use_one_agent_conversation_model.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-023\\r\\ninternalId: 1244ac27-293a-4a5f-b478-0890ecc3fea6\\r\\ntitle: use one agent conversation model while growing and persisted\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - app/src/data/action_run_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/data/data_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_execution.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_runner_service.js\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: 5b39ff1e-4bbc-4d50-b527-36e1d1faa6f5\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nFollow J-020 by removing the remaining `LiveAgentTurn` model. This duplicates models, metadata, and ownership.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Remove `LiveAgentTurn` and `liveAgentConversation`.\\r\\n- Store `AgentConversation | null` directly in run state.\\r\\n- Make the agent-start event provide the complete canonical conversation snapshot, including identity, metadata, path, status, and initial entries.\\r\\n- Apply later message/event updates immutably to that conversation\u0027s `entries` without changing entry order.\\r\\n- Apply status and completion metadata to the same model.\\r\\n- Persist and reload the same `AgentConversation` shape.\\r\\n- Continuation starts from the canonical source conversation and adds new entries without a renderer-side merge.\\r\\n- Do not add live/persisted adapters, compatibility shapes, or duplicated fields.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- [ ] `LiveAgentTurn` and `liveAgentConversation` no longer exist.\\r\\n- [ ] Growing, completed, persisted, loaded, and continued conversations all use `AgentConversation`.\\r\\n- [ ] Run state exposes the canonical conversation directly.\\r\\n- [ ] Popup rendering performs no conversation-shape conversion or history merge.\\r\\n- [ ] Entry identity and order remain stable during streamed updates.\\r\\n- [ ] App and desktop lint and tests pass.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Dependency\\r\\n\\r\\nJ-020 must be implemented first.\\r\\n\\n===== J_024_replace_execution_state_with_scoped_action_runs.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-024\\r\\ninternalId: 1975a005-f0bb-432f-8ecb-bc85a27819d2\\r\\ntitle: replace global execution state with scoped action runs\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - app/src/data/action_run_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/data/electron_action_bridge.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/hooks/use_action_executions.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\\r\\n  - Unrelated run changes must preserve selected store snapshots and must not render their consumers.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Persistence and lifecycle\\r\\n\\r\\n\\n===== J_025_move_action_popup_state_to_leaf_owners.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-025\\r\\ninternalId: 96705093-a302-409d-b626-fe3e16fd28e2\\r\\ntitle: move action popup state and subscriptions to leaf owners\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup_content.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_selector.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_conversation_chat.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_log_error_display.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_agent_approval.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_agent_question.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup_bottom_row.tsx\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: 1975a005-f0bb-432f-8ecb-bc85a27819d2\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nMake popup roots own layout and selection only. Move changing application data, subscriptions, and operations to the smallest component that renders or acts on them.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Remove `useActionPopupController`; do not replace it with another aggregate controller.\\r\\n- Remove active-run subscriptions from `ActionPopup` and `ActionPopupContent`.\\r\\n- Keep popup initialization as a one-time action/context binding lookup without subscribing the root.\\r\\n- Give `ActionSelector` a context-scoped status subscription.\\r\\n- Give the conversation section a subscription to only its bound run\u0027s canonical conversation.\\r\\n- Give status/log, approval, question, and run-control leaves their required run-store subscriptions.\\r\\n- Use the stable prompt store from J-022 only in the editor and prompt-dependent controls.\\r\\n- Put conversation-history loading and selection in the conversation owner, not the popup root.\\r\\n- Move schedule state and run-history loading to their existing leaf sections.\\r\\n- Event handlers read current service/store state when invoked; changing state is not routed through root props.\\r\\n- Do not use memoization as the ownership fix. Memoization may be added only after subscription boundaries are correct.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Render contract\\r\\n\\r\\n- Conversation entry updates render only the conversation leaf.\\r\\n- Run status changes render only leaves that display or depend on status.\\r\\n- Logs, approvals, and questions render only their owners.\\r\\n- Status changes for another action or card render nothing in this popup.\\r\\n- Prompt typing and flush render no popup root or unrelated section.\\r\\n- Markdown-style changes update Markdown consumers through J-021 without rebuilding styles locally.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Testing implications\\r\\n\\r\\n- Add render-count regression tests around `ActionPopup` and `ActionPopupContent`.\\r\\n- Prove another card/action run cannot render this popup.\\r\\n- Prove conversation streaming renders only the conversation boundary.\\r\\n\",\ndesign\\activity\\project.json:176:          \"output\": \"\\n===== B_80_worktree_selector_not_updated.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: B_80\\r\\ninternalId: e69b9faf-30dd-4ad6-9d99-7e6af4d18c76\\r\\ntitle: worktree selector not updated\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\n  - design/activity/card__e69b9faf-30dd-4ad6-9d99-7e6af4d18c76.json#conversation=agent-e533433a-31ad-4168-8a1c-f57869151ddd\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: \\r\\n---\\r\\nafter the \u0027integrate into project\u0027 command is run on a card that is assigned to a worktree, the worktree selector icon is not updated and the wrong state is shown on the card. if the user clicks again on the icon and runs the \u0027integrate into project\u0027 again, the app gives an error to say nothing left to integrate. then the icon gets updated correctly\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current state\\r\\n\\r\\n`WorktreeSelector` derives its arrows and enabled actions from records published by `WorktreeService`. Development-mode React work and garbage collection amplify the cost.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis bypasses the lifetime-stable editor approach already used by `CardEditor` and `CardBodyEditor`. `MarkdownEditor` already buffers local edits and exposes `getMarkdown`, `setMarkdown`, and `flush`; normal typing does not need to propagate the full body into parent React state.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Keep the new-card Markdown editor lifetime-stable while typing, following `CardEditor` and `CardBodyEditor`.\\r\\n- Do not store the full Markdown body in `NewCardDialog` state on every keystroke.\\r\\n- Read the current body from the editor when submitting, checking whether the draft is dirty, and inserting or clearing the template.\\r\\n- Preserve existing template behavior: untouched template can be cleared; editing it changes the action back to `Template`; inserting then appends without discarding text.\\r\\n- Keep reset, cancel confirmation, `Ctrl+Enter`, and target-column behavior unchanged.\\r\\n- Do not change shared `MarkdownEditor` buffering semantics solely for this dialog.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- [ ] Typing in the new-card description does not rerender `NewCardDialog` or remount/rerender the Markdown editor for every keystroke.\\r\\n- [ ] Submitted card body exactly matches current editor content.\\r\\n- [ ] Cancel confirmation detects description-only edits.\\r\\n- [ ] Template insert, clear, edit, and append behavior remains unchanged.\\r\\n- [ ] Opening, closing, successful creation, and project changes reset the draft correctly.\\r\\n- [ ] A regression test verifies repeated description edits do not repeatedly render the editor boundary.\\r\\n- [ ] Existing new-card dialog and Markdown editor tests pass.\\r\\n\\n===== B_82_orphaned_git_for_windows_processes.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: B_82\\r\\ninternalId: d97a054f-5a67-47bb-9070-df874cf9148e\\r\\ntitle: agent runs leave orphaned Git for Windows processes\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: 7bdf27fc-963c-4545-83e2-93410e67f0e3\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Problem\\r\\n\\r\\nAgent runs launched through MDÃ‚Â² can leave multiple `git.exe` processes running indefinitely. The processes appear as **Git for Windows** in Task Manager and accumulate across runs.\\r\\n\\r\\nObserved processes were executing normally short-lived commands such as `config`, `rev-parse`, `remote -v`, and `status --porcelain`. They remained alive after their immediate parent processes had exited.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current implementation\\r\\n\\r\\nMDÃ‚Â² starts agents through `AgentRunnerService`. When an agent closes normally, `handleClose` queries the current Windows process tree and terminates descendants of the agent PID. Cancellation terminates the process tree with `taskkill /t /f`.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis cleanup cannot discover a surviving Git process after an intermediate parent has already exited: the current process snapshot no longer contains a complete chain from the agent PID to that Git process. The observed Git processes had dead immediate parents, matching this failure mode.\\r\\n\\r\\nMDÃ‚Â² also invokes Git directly through `git_commands.js`. These calls have no timeout or cancellation handling, so an independently hung app-owned Git command can block its caller indefinitely.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Investigation plan\\r\\n\\r\\n1. Reproduce with MDÃ‚Â² open but no agent run, then while starting and completing or cancelling an agent run.\\r\\n2. Record every spawned Git PID, command, working directory, parent PID, agent run ID, and lifecycle event.\\r\\n3. Run an affected command under a bounded external timeout with Git tracing enabled to locate the blocking operation.\\r\\n4. Check repository state, Git configuration, filesystem monitoring, antivirus or file locks, and agent shutdown ordering.\\r\\n5. Confirm whether Git descendants become disconnected before `AgentRunnerService.handleClose` takes its process snapshot.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Track enough process ownership during an agent run to terminate surviving descendants even when intermediate processes exit before final cleanup.\\r\\n- Clean up owned descendants when an agent completes, fails, is cancelled, or crashes.\\r\\n- Do not terminate unrelated Git processes or Git work started outside the corresponding MDÃ‚Â² agent run.\\r\\n- Add a bounded timeout and process cleanup to direct Git execution in `git_commands.js`.\\r\\n- Include the command, working directory, elapsed time, and owning run or app operation in timeout diagnostics.\\r\\n- Deduplicate or serialize repeated read-only metadata probes only if tracing confirms they contribute to the accumulation.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Failure modes and compatibility\\r\\n\\r\\n- PID reuse must not allow cleanup to target a process that MDÃ‚Â² did not start.\\r\\n- Cleanup must cover shell and helper-process chains used by Git for Windows on Windows.\\r\\n- Long-running network Git operations need an explicit, suitable timeout rather than the same threshold as local metadata commands.\\r\\n- Existing agent cancellation, command actions, commits, worktree operations, push, pull, and fetch behavior must remain unchanged apart from bounded failure and cleanup.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- [ ] Completing, failing, cancelling, or crashing an agent run leaves no Git processes owned by that run.\\r\\n- [ ] Repeated agent runs do not accumulate Git for Windows processes.\\r\\n\\n===== B_85_add_the_reference_to_a_chatlog_to_a_card_as_soon_as_possible.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: B_85\\r\\ninternalId: 56dd54b0-9554-4545-85d4-bb45efef4d6e\\r\\ntitle: add the reference to a chatlog to a card as soon as possible\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\n  - Primary checkpoint and activity-file commits are not included.\\r\\n- The squash commit appears once under `Integrate into project` in the existing card commit selector and opens one combined diff for the integration.\\r\\n- Integration with no outgoing commits or no combined change remains rejected and creates no activity record.\\r\\n- Failed integration creates no activity record. History-persistence failure after a successful squash commit is visible.\\r\\n- Project-level worktree integration creates no card activity.\\r\\n- Tests cover one and several source commits producing one squash commit, rebase before integration, stable card ownership, squash cleanup and persistence failure paths, and project-level exclusion.\\r\\n\\n===== F_96_ctrl_enter_on_action_input.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: F_96\\r\\ninternalId: d33002d3-ee0e-4c08-8e26-36f790500ee2\\r\\ntitle: ctrl enter on action input\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: d4afff38-5581-42f4-a8f3-8ded807ab27a\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\nwhen pressing ctrl + enter on action input, the input is sent, this is good, but before this happens, the input box still adds an enter, which should not be the case.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Current state\\r\\n\\r\\n`ActionAgentPrompt` handles `Ctrl+Enter` and `Meta+Enter` on the prompt wrapper during event bubbling. MDXEditor handles `Enter` first, inserts a newline, then the wrapper flushes and sends the changed prompt.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Intercept `Ctrl+Enter` and `Meta+Enter` during capture, before MDXEditor handles the key.\\r\\n- Prevent default behavior and stop propagation, then flush the latest prompt before running the existing shortcut callback.\\r\\n- Keep plain `Enter`, `Shift+Enter`, and disabled shortcut behavior unchanged.\\r\\n- Extend `action_agent_prompt.test.tsx` with regression coverage proving the editor does not receive the send shortcut.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- `Ctrl+Enter` sends current prompt without inserting a newline.\\r\\n- `Meta+Enter` has same behavior.\\r\\n- Prompt is flushed before send callback runs.\\r\\n- Plain `Enter` and `Shift+Enter` still insert newlines.\\r\\n\\n===== F_98_worktree_vs_project_folder_placeholders.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: F_98\\r\\ninternalId: ff356504-eed4-47f3-bb38-2c749b6fcba6\\r\\ntitle: worktree vs project folder placeholders\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: d33002d3-ee0e-4c08-8e26-36f790500ee2\\r\\n---\\r\\nWe have \u0027rootProjectFolder\u0027 placeholder. this currently maps to the folder that the agent is running on, so it could the the main project folder or a worktree.\u0026#x20;\\r\\n\\r\\nWe need to improve this and split it up in `worktree-folder` and \u0027project-folder\u0027 where the last one always references the main project folder while \u0027worktree-folder\u0027 references the folder that the agent is currently running in.\\r\\n\\r\\nAlso, we need to add the \u0027releases-folder\u0027 as well\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current state\\r\\n\\r\\n- `{{rootProjectFolder}}` exists in action prompt/command and diff-command placeholder sets.\\r\\n- Action execution resolves it to the execution checkout, which may be the opened project folder or a linked worktree. Diff commands resolve it to the opened project folder.\\r\\n- Action editor insertion controls and user documentation expose only the existing placeholder.\\r\\n\\r\\n## implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Replace `{{rootProjectFolder}}` everywhere with `{{worktree-folder}}` and `{{project-folder}}`; do not keep a legacy alias.\\r\\n- `{{worktree-folder}}` resolves to the absolute execution checkout path. When no linked worktree is selected, it equals `{{project-folder}}`.\\r\\n- `{{project-folder}}` always resolves to the absolute opened repository path, including during linked-worktree execution.\\r\\n- Add `{{releases-folder}}`, resolving to the configured repository-relative releases path: `\u003cprojectFolder\u003e/\u003creleasesFolder\u003e`.\\r\\n- Support all three placeholders in action prompts, action commands, prompt preparation, diff commands, editor insertion controls, validation, and documentation.\\r\\n- Fail before process start when a required placeholder value is unavailable. Add tests for primary and linked-worktree execution, custom release paths, diff commands, insertion controls, and removed `{{rootProjectFolder}}` support.\\r\\n\\r\\n## acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- Primary-checkout actions resolve `{{worktree-folder}}` and `{{project-folder}}` to the opened repository path.\\r\\n- Linked-worktree actions resolve `{{worktree-folder}}` to that worktree and `{{project-folder}}` to the opened repository path.\\r\\n- `{{releases-folder}}` returns the configured path relative to repository root, independent of active checkout.\\r\\n- Action prompts, action commands, and diff commands use the same three folder placeholders.\\r\\n- Editors and documentation list the new placeholders and no longer list `{{rootProjectFolder}}`.\\r\\n- `{{rootProjectFolder}}` is not resolved.\\r\\n\\n===== J_020_unify_agent_conversation_entries.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-020\\r\\ninternalId: 4edefccb-f7e3-4ae1-9c0d-5939ac1d3745\\r\\ntitle: unify agent conversation messages and events into ordered entries\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - shared/agent_conversations.mjs\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_conversation.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_runner_service.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_transcript.js\\r\\n  - app/src/data/data_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/data/action_run_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/agents/card_agent_state.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_conversation_chat.tsx\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: c5d963f2-ca43-419d-bc3c-972199b7e7cd\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nReplace the parallel agent-conversation `messages` and `events` arrays with one canonical ordered `entries` array. Array position is ingestion order and is the only display order.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis refactor must land before the action-popup rendering-isolation work. That work must consume the single entry list and must not preserve the current merge-and-sort path.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Terminology\\r\\n\\r\\n- **Conversation entry**: one ordered item in an agent conversation.\\r\\n- **Message entry**: user or assistant text.\\r\\n- **Event entry**: reasoning, tool use, command execution, diagnostics, failures, and lifecycle observations.\\r\\n\\r\\nDo not use **activity** for a conversation entry, field, helper, component, or collection. `activity` remains valid only for the separate card/project activity-storage domain.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current architecture\\r\\n\\r\\nPersisted `AgentConversation` stores `messages` and `events` separately. Live execution repeats the split as `LiveAgentTurn.messages` and `LiveAgentTurn.activities`. Producers append or replace items in those separate collections, while chat and transcript consumers merge and sort them by `sequence` to reconstruct ingestion order.\\r\\n\\r\\nThe split causes:\\r\\n\\r\\n- duplicate persisted and live representations;\\r\\n- inconsistent `event`/`activity` terminology;\\r\\n- repeated merge and sort work in consumers;\\r\\n- a rebuilt full `AgentConversation` projection in the popup controller;\\r\\n- ordering behavior owned by presentation code instead of the producer.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required model\\r\\n\\r\\nUse a discriminated union and one collection:\\r\\n\\r\\n```ts\\r\\n\\n===== J_021_derive_markdown_styles_globally.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-021\\r\\ninternalId: 11ffc4ac-44e0-4dab-a8d9-af9e83a43aff\\r\\ntitle: derive active Markdown content styles once in the global theme\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - app/src/theme/theme_context.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/theme/theme_provider.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/theme/theme_provider.test.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/theme/use_app_theme.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/editor/markdown_style_sx.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/editor/markdown_editor.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_conversation_chat.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/config/markdown_style_preview.tsx\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: 4edefccb-f7e3-4ae1-9c0d-5939ac1d3745\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nBuild the active Markdown content styling once when the global Markdown style configuration changes. Components that render active Markdown consume the stable derived style and never rebuild it during unrelated renders.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis job is independent of the action-popup subscription refactor and should land before performance verification of that refactor.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current architecture\\r\\n\\r\\n`AppThemeProvider` owns `markdownStyleConfig`, but consumers receive only the raw configuration. Both `MarkdownEditor` and `ActionConversationChat` call `buildMarkdownContentSx(markdownStyleConfig)` in their render bodies. The builder creates a new nested MUI style object even when the configuration is unchanged.\\r\\n\\r\\n`MarkdownStylePreview` also calls the builder, but it renders an explicit configuration draft rather than the active global style.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Derive a stable `markdownContentSx` value in `AppThemeProvider` with `useMemo`, depending only on `markdownStyleConfig`.\\r\\n- Expose the derived value through `AppThemeContextValue` and its fallback value.\\r\\n- Make `MarkdownEditor` and `ActionConversationChat` consume `markdownContentSx` directly.\\r\\n- Do not call `buildMarkdownContentSx` from either component.\\r\\n- Keep `buildMarkdownContentSx` as a pure derivation function owned by the theme/style layer.\\r\\n- Memoize `MarkdownStylePreview`\u0027s derived style by its explicit `config` prop. The preview cannot consume the active global style because it must show unsaved draft configuration.\\r\\n- Do not introduce a service class; this is a pure derived theme value.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Identity contract\\r\\n\\r\\n- `markdownContentSx` retains object identity across renders when `markdownStyleConfig` is unchanged.\\r\\n- Changing palette mode, popup state, editor content, conversation content, or unrelated configuration does not rebuild it.\\r\\n- Changing the active Markdown style configuration rebuilds it once and updates all active Markdown consumers.\\r\\n- Changing the preview\u0027s explicit draft configuration rebuilds only the preview value.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Testing implications\\r\\n\\r\\n- Theme-provider tests prove the derived style is exposed and retains identity across unrelated provider renders.\\r\\n- Theme-provider tests prove changing `markdownStyleConfig` replaces the derived value.\\r\\n\\n===== J_022_stabilize_action_prompt_drafts.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-022\\r\\ninternalId: 5b39ff1e-4bbc-4d50-b527-36e1d1faa6f5\\r\\ntitle: move action prompt drafts out of popup React state\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_prompt_draft.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_agent_prompt.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup_bottom_row.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup_content.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: 11ffc4ac-44e0-4dab-a8d9-af9e83a43aff\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nGive each action prompt draft one lifetime-stable external store. Typing, flushing, preparing, replacing, clearing, restoring, and remotely synchronizing a prompt must not place the prompt text or reset counters in `ActionPopupContent` or its controller React state.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis job must land before the major action-popup ownership and subscription refactor.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current architecture\\r\\n\\r\\nPrompt ownership is duplicated:\\r\\n\\r\\n- `useActionPopupController` stores prompt value, preparation status, and reset token in React state.\\r\\n- `ActionPopupContent` creates a new `ActionPromptDraft` whenever the controller prompt or reset token changes.\\r\\n- `ActionPromptDraft` buffers live editor values and supports a narrow bottom-row subscription.\\r\\n- `ActionExecutionService` separately stores prompt values, revisions, pending bridge writes, and remote prompt sessions.\\r\\n\\r\\nOrdinary typing already stays out of root React state because `MarkdownEditor.onLiveChange` writes to `ActionPromptDraft`. Editor flush still calls `setPromptState`, and external preparation/replacement/clear operations update root state and replace the draft object. Those paths rerender the complete popup.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required ownership\\r\\n\\r\\nCreate one prompt-draft service that owns stable draft stores keyed by the action context and, when applicable, the active agent session. The service is justified because it owns state, draft lifecycle, asynchronous bridge synchronization, revisions, and pending writes.\\r\\n\\r\\nMove the current prompt-draft map and remote prompt-session behavior out of `ActionExecutionService`. The renamed run/session service planned by the later popup refactor must not retain prompt text ownership.\\r\\n\\r\\nEach stable draft store exposes, at minimum:\\r\\n\\r\\n- current Markdown value;\\r\\n- preparation state: `loading`, `ready`, or `failed`;\\r\\n- a narrow subscription contract suitable for `useSyncExternalStore`;\\r\\n- local edit without React parent state;\\r\\n- external replacement that notifies the editor to call `setMarkdown` once;\\r\\n- clear, flush/synchronize, send, and current-value reads;\\r\\n- revision protection for superseded asynchronous preparation and remote writes.\\r\\n\\r\\nDo not add arbitrary retention limits or silent eviction. Draft removal must follow explicit lifecycle events such as successful send, deliberate clear, action removal, or project teardown. A popup unmount does not discard an unsent draft.\\r\\n\\r\\n\\n===== J_023_use_one_agent_conversation_model.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-023\\r\\ninternalId: 1244ac27-293a-4a5f-b478-0890ecc3fea6\\r\\ntitle: use one agent conversation model while growing and persisted\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - app/src/data/action_run_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/data/data_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_execution.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_runner_service.js\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: 5b39ff1e-4bbc-4d50-b527-36e1d1faa6f5\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nFollow J-020 by removing the remaining `LiveAgentTurn` model. A growing conversation and a persisted conversation are the same `AgentConversation`; persistence is only a lifecycle state.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current problem\\r\\n\\r\\nJ-020 unified conversation content into `entries`, but renderer run state still stores `LiveAgentTurn`. `useActionPopupController` converts that object into a new `AgentConversation` during rendering. This duplicates models, metadata, and ownership.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Remove `LiveAgentTurn` and `liveAgentConversation`.\\r\\n- Store `AgentConversation | null` directly in run state.\\r\\n- Make the agent-start event provide the complete canonical conversation snapshot, including identity, metadata, path, status, and initial entries.\\r\\n- Apply later message/event updates immutably to that conversation\u0027s `entries` without changing entry order.\\r\\n- Apply status and completion metadata to the same model.\\r\\n- Persist and reload the same `AgentConversation` shape.\\r\\n- Continuation starts from the canonical source conversation and adds new entries without a renderer-side merge.\\r\\n- Do not add live/persisted adapters, compatibility shapes, or duplicated fields.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- [ ] `LiveAgentTurn` and `liveAgentConversation` no longer exist.\\r\\n- [ ] Growing, completed, persisted, loaded, and continued conversations all use `AgentConversation`.\\r\\n- [ ] Run state exposes the canonical conversation directly.\\r\\n- [ ] Popup rendering performs no conversation-shape conversion or history merge.\\r\\n- [ ] Entry identity and order remain stable during streamed updates.\\r\\n- [ ] App and desktop lint and tests pass.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Dependency\\r\\n\\r\\nJ-020 must be implemented first.\\r\\n\\n===== J_024_replace_execution_state_with_scoped_action_runs.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-024\\r\\ninternalId: 1975a005-f0bb-432f-8ecb-bc85a27819d2\\r\\ntitle: replace global execution state with scoped action runs\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - app/src/data/action_run_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/data/electron_action_bridge.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/hooks/use_action_executions.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_execution.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_runner_service.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/shell/local_bridge_dispatch.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/shell/preload.js\\r\\n  - shared/card_activity.mjs\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: 1244ac27-293a-4a5f-b478-0890ecc3fea6\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nReplace execution terminology and the global renderer snapshot with action-run terminology, a routing registry, and stable scoped run stores.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Terminology\\r\\n\\r\\n- `runId`, not `executionId`.\\r\\n- `ActionRun`, not `LiveActionExecution` or action execution.\\r\\n- `ActionRunRegistry`, not `ActionExecutionService`.\\r\\n- `ActionRunStore`: stable state owner for one run.\\r\\n- `runs`, not `executions`.\\r\\n- `ConversationEntry` remains reserved for items inside an agent conversation.\\r\\n\\r\\nRename the contract consistently across Electron, bridge messages, renderer services, hooks, persisted action records, errors, and tests. Process execution may keep that term only where it refers to an operating-system process.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Registry shape\\r\\n\\r\\n`ActionRunRegistry` keeps one renderer-wide bridge subscription and a routing map from `runId` to stable `ActionRunStore`. The map is an internal index, not a React snapshot.\\r\\n\\r\\nEach `ActionRunStore` owns one run\u0027s status, logs, root action, active chained action, context, conversation, approvals, and question. Incoming events identify `runId`, root action ID, active action ID, and context, then update only that store.\\r\\n\\r\\nProvide separate scoped indexes/subscriptions for:\\r\\n\\r\\n- one run by `runId`;\\r\\n- the run bound to one root action and context;\\r\\n- active statuses for one context;\\r\\n- the global active-run list used only by the global indicator.\\r\\n\\r\\nRemove the undifferentiated global `changed` event and complete-run snapshot. Unrelated run changes must preserve selected store snapshots and must not render their consumers.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Persistence and lifecycle\\r\\n\\r\\n\\n===== J_025_move_action_popup_state_to_leaf_owners.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-025\\r\\ninternalId: 96705093-a302-409d-b626-fe3e16fd28e2\\r\\ntitle: move action popup state and subscriptions to leaf owners\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup_content.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_selector.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_conversation_chat.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_log_error_display.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_agent_approval.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_agent_question.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup_bottom_row.tsx\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: 1975a005-f0bb-432f-8ecb-bc85a27819d2\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nMake popup roots own layout and selection only. Move changing application data, subscriptions, and operations to the smallest component that renders or acts on them.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Remove `useActionPopupController`; do not replace it with another aggregate controller.\\r\\n- Remove active-run subscriptions from `ActionPopup` and `ActionPopupContent`.\\r\\n- Keep popup initialization as a one-time action/context binding lookup without subscribing the root.\\r\\n- Give `ActionSelector` a context-scoped status subscription.\\r\\n- Give the conversation section a subscription to only its bound run\u0027s canonical conversation.\\r\\n- Give status/log, approval, question, and run-control leaves their required run-store subscriptions.\\r\\n- Use the stable prompt store from J-022 only in the editor and prompt-dependent controls.\\r\\n- Put conversation-history loading and selection in the conversation owner, not the popup root.\\r\\n- Move schedule state and run-history loading to their existing leaf sections.\\r\\n- Event handlers read current service/store state when invoked; changing state is not routed through root props.\\r\\n- Do not use memoization as the ownership fix. Memoization may be added only after subscription boundaries are correct.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Render contract\\r\\n\\r\\n- Conversation entry updates render only the conversation leaf.\\r\\n- Run status changes render only leaves that display or depend on status.\\r\\n- Logs, approvals, and questions render only their owners.\\r\\n- Status changes for another action or card render nothing in this popup.\\r\\n- Prompt typing and flush render no popup root or unrelated section.\\r\\n- Markdown-style changes update Markdown consumers through J-021 without rebuilding styles locally.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Testing implications\\r\\n\\r\\n- Add render-count regression tests around `ActionPopup` and `ActionPopupContent`.\\r\\n- Prove another card/action run cannot render this popup.\\r\\n- Prove on the icon and runs the \u0027integrate into project\u0027 again, the app gives an error to say nothing left to integrate. then the icon gets updated correctly\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Current state\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n`WorktreeSelector` derives its arrows and enabled actions from records published by `WorktreeService`. Integration creates a squash commit on the project branch, but leaves the linked branch on its original commits. Git therefore still reports the worktree as ahead and behind. A second integration rebases away those already-integrated commits, publishes the corrected state, then fails because nothing remains to integrate.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nCard integration also commits its activity record after the integration refresh, so that new project commit is absent from the published status.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## implementation details\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n- After a successful squash, move the clean linked branch to the integration commit before publishing worktree state. Keep its assignment and branch; do not park or unassign it.\\\\r\\\\n- After card activity persistence completes, synchronize the linked branch to the new project head and publish worktree state again.\\\\r\\\\n- Keep project-level integration on the shared synchronization path; it needs no activity refresh.\\\\r\\\\n- Preserve existing integration and activity-persistence errors. Existing renderer subscription should update without component-local state.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## acceptance criteria\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n- Successful integration immediately removes the outgoing indicator and disables `Integrate into project`.\\\\r\\\\n- Card integration finishes with no outgoing or incoming indicator and disables both integration and update actions.\\\\r\\\\n- Reopening the selector or waiting for polling is unnecessary.\\\\r\\\\n- A second integration is not required to correct the icon and is unavailable when no outgoing changes remain.\\\\r\\\\n- Card and project integrations publish correct final worktree status; failure behavior remains unchanged.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\n===== B_81_new_card_markdown_typing_lag.md =====\\\\r\\\\n---\\\\r\\\\nauthor:\\\\r\\\\nid: B_81\\\\r\\\\ninternalId: 8e4a295a-8788-4232-8be7-c97f5a1cf5c8\\\\r\\\\ntitle: new card Markdown typing lag\\\\r\\\\nstatus: ready\\\\r\\\\nowner:\\\\r\\\\naffects:\\\\r\\\\nagents:\\\\r\\\\npolicy:\\\\r\\\\nafter: ff356504-eed4-47f3-bb38-2c749b6fcba6\\\\r\\\\n---\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Problem\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nTyping in the **New card** description editor has noticeable input lag.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nPerformance trace `Trace-20260731T140458.json` records five input events that each block the renderer main thread for 52-64 ms. Layout and paint are small; synchronous React work consumes most of the time.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Cause\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n`NewCardDialog` passes `handleBodyChange` to `MarkdownEditor.onLiveChange`. Every editor change calls `setBody`, rerendering the complete dialog and the MDXEditor subtree. This also recreates the Markdown editor plugin array and many MUI elements and style objects. Development-mode React work and garbage collection amplify the cost.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nThis bypasses the lifetime-stable editor approach already used by `CardEditor` and `CardBodyEditor`. `MarkdownEditor` already buffers local edits and exposes `getMarkdown`, `setMarkdown`, and `flush`; normal typing does not need to propagate the full body into parent React state.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Required change\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n- Keep the new-card Markdown editor lifetime-stable while typing, following `CardEditor` and `CardBodyEditor`.\\\\r\\\\n- Do not store the full Markdown body in `NewCardDialog` state on every keystroke.\\\\r\\\\n- Read the current body from the editor when submitting, checking whether the draft is dirty, and inserting or clearing the template.\\\\r\\\\n- Preserve existing template behavior: untouched template can be cleared; The processes appear as **Git for Windows** in Task Manager and accumulate across runs.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nObserved processes were executing normally short-lived commands such as `config`, `rev-parse`, `remote -v`, and `status --porcelain`. They remained alive after their immediate parent processes had exited.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Current implementation\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nMDÃ‚Â² starts agents through `AgentRunnerService`. When an agent closes normally, `handleClose` queries the current Windows process tree and terminates descendants of the agent PID. Cancellation terminates the process tree with `taskkill /t /f`.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nThis cleanup cannot discover a surviving Git process after an intermediate parent has already exited: the current process snapshot no longer contains a complete chain from the agent PID to that Git process. The observed Git processes had dead immediate parents, matching this failure mode.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nMDÃ‚Â² also invokes Git directly through `git_commands.js`. These calls have no timeout or cancellation handling, so an independently hung app-owned Git command can block its caller indefinitely.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Investigation plan\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n1. Reproduce with MDÃ‚Â² open but no agent run, then while starting and completing or cancelling an agent run.\\\\r\\\\n2. Record every spawned Git PID, command, working directory, parent PID, agent run ID, and lifecycle event.\\\\r\\\\n3. Run an affected command under a bounded external timeout with Git tracing enabled to locate the blocking operation.\\\\r\\\\n4. Check repository state, Git configuration, filesystem monitoring, antivirus or file locks, and agent shutdown ordering.\\\\r\\\\n5. Confirm whether Git descendants become disconnected before `AgentRunnerService.handleClose` takes its process snapshot.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Required change\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n- Track enough process ownership during an agent run to terminate surviving descendants even when intermediate processes exit before final cleanup.\\\\r\\\\n- Clean up owned descendants when an agent completes, fails, is cancelled, or crashes.\\\\r\\\\n- Do not terminate unrelated Git processes or Git work started outside the corresponding MDÃ‚Â² agent run.\\\\r\\\\n- Add a bounded timeout and process cleanup to direct Git execution in `git_commands.js`.\\\\r\\\\n- Include the command, working directory, elapsed time, and owning run or app operation in timeout diagnostics.\\\\r\\\\n- Deduplicate or serialize repeated read-only metadata probes only if tracing confirms they contribute to the accumulation.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Failure modes and compatibility\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n- PID reuse must not allow cleanup to target a process that MDÃ‚Â² did not start.\\\\r\\\\n- Cleanup must cover shell and helper-process chains used by Git for Windows on Windows.\\\\r\\\\n- Long-running network Git operations need an explicit, suitable timeout rather than the same threshold as local metadata commands.\\\\r\\\\n- Existing agent cancellation, command actions, commits, worktree operations, push, pull, and fetch behavior must remain unchanged apart from bounded failure and cleanup.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Acceptance criteria\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n- [ ] Completing, failing, cancelling, or crashing an agent run leaves no Git processes owned by that run.\\\\r\\\\n- [ ] Repeated agent runs do not accumulate Git for Windows processes.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\n===== The service is justified because it owns state, draft lifecycle, asynchronous bridge synchronization, revisions, and pending writes.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nMove the current prompt-draft map and remote prompt-session behavior out of `ActionExecutionService`. Draft removal must follow explicit lifecycle events such as successful send, deliberate clear, action removal, or project teardown. A popup unmount does not discard an unsent draft.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n\\\\n===== J_023_use_one_agent_conversation_model.md =====\\\\r\\\\n---\\\\r\\\\nauthor:\\\\r\\\\nid: J-023\\\\r\\\\ninternalId: 1244ac27-293a-4a5f-b478-0890ecc3fea6\\\\r\\\\ntitle: use one agent conversation model while growing and persisted\\\\r\\\\nstatus: ready\\\\r\\\\nowner:\\\\r\\\\naffects:\\\\r\\\\n  - app/src/data/action_run_types.ts\\\\r\\\\n  - app/src/data/data_types.ts\\\\r\\\\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\\\\r\\\\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\\\\r\\\\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_execution.js\\\\r\\\\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_runner_service.js\\\\r\\\\npolicy:\\\\r\\\\n  checkLinting: true\\\\r\\\\n  requireTests: true\\\\r\\\\nafter: 5b39ff1e-4bbc-4d50-b527-36e1d1faa6f5\\\\r\\\\n---\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Goal\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nFollow J-020 by removing the remaining `LiveAgentTurn` model. Unrelated run changes must preserve selected store snapshots and must not render their consumers.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Persistence and lifecycle\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n\\\\n===== J_025_move_action_popup_state_to_leaf_owners.md =====\\\\r\\\\n---\\\\r\\\\nauthor:\\\\r\\\\nid: J-025\\\\r\\\\ninternalId: 96705093-a302-409d-b626-fe3e16fd28e2\\\\r\\\\ntitle: move action popup state and subscriptions to leaf owners\\\\r\\\\nstatus: ready\\\\r\\\\nowner:\\\\r\\\\naffects:\\\\r\\\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup.tsx\\\\r\\\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup_content.tsx\\\\r\\\\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\\\\r\\\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_selector.tsx\\\\r\\\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_conversation_chat.tsx\\\\r\\\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_log_error_display.tsx\\\\r\\\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_agent_approval.tsx\\\\r\\\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_agent_question.tsx\\\\r\\\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup_bottom_row.tsx\\\\r\\\\npolicy:\\\\r\\\\n  checkLinting: true\\\\r\\\\n  requireTests: true\\\\r\\\\nafter: 1975a005-f0bb-432f-8ecb-bc85a27819d2\\\\r\\\\n---\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Goal\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nMake popup roots own layout and selection only. Existing renderer subscription should update without component-local state.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## acceptance criteria\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n- Successful integration immediately removes the outgoing indicator and disables `Integrate into project`.\\\\r\\\\n- Card integration finishes with no outgoing or incoming indicator and disables both integration and update actions.\\\\r\\\\n- Reopening the selector or waiting for polling is unnecessary.\\\\r\\\\n- A second integration is not required to correct the icon and is unavailable when no outgoing changes remain.\\\\r\\\\n- Card and project integrations publish correct final worktree status; failure behavior remains unchanged.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\n===== B_81_new_card_markdown_typing_lag.md =====\\\\r\\\\n---\\\\r\\\\nauthor:\\\\r\\\\nid: B_81\\\\r\\\\ninternalId: 8e4a295a-8788-4232-8be7-c97f5a1cf5c8\\\\r\\\\ntitle: new card Markdown typing lag\\\\r\\\\nstatus: ready\\\\r\\\\nowner:\\\\r\\\\naffects:\\\\r\\\\nagents:\\\\r\\\\npolicy:\\\\r\\\\nafter: ff356504-eed4-47f3-bb38-2c749b6fcba6\\\\r\\\\n---\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Problem\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nTyping in the **New card** description editor has noticeable input lag.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nPerformance trace `Trace-20260731T140458.json` records five input events that each block the renderer main thread for 52-64 ms. Layout and paint are small; synchronous React work consumes most of the time.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Cause\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n`NewCardDialog` passes `handleBodyChange` to `MarkdownEditor.onLiveChange`. Every editor change calls `setBody`, rerendering the complete dialog and the MDXEditor subtree. This also recreates the Markdown editor plugin array and many MUI elements and style objects. Development-mode React work and garbage collection amplify the cost.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nThis bypasses the lifetime-stable editor approach already used by `CardEditor` and `CardBodyEditor`. `MarkdownEditor` already buffers local edits and exposes `getMarkdown`, `setMarkdown`, and `flush`; normal typing does not need to propagate the full body into parent React state.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Required change\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n- Keep the new-card Markdown editor lifetime-stable while typing, following `CardEditor` and `CardBodyEditor`.\\\\r\\\\n- Do not store the full Markdown body in `NewCardDialog` state on every keystroke.\\\\r\\\\n- Read the current body from the editor when submitting, checking whether the draft is dirty, and inserting or clearing the template.\\\\r\\\\n- Preserve existing template behavior: untouched template can be cleared; editing it changes the action back to `Template`; inserting then appends without discarding text.\\\\r\\\\n- Keep reset, cancel confirmation, `Ctrl+Enter`, and target-column behavior unchanged.\\\\r\\\\n- Do not change shared `MarkdownEditor` buffering semantics solely for this dialog.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Acceptance criteria\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n- [ ] Typing in the new-card description does not rerender `NewCardDialog` or remount/rerender the Markdown editor for every keystroke.\\\\r\\\\n- [ ] Submitted card body exactly matches current editor content.\\\\r\\\\n- [ ] Cancel confirmation detects description-only edits.\\\\r\\\\n- [ ] Template insert, clear, edit, and append behavior remains unchanged.\\\\r\\\\n- [ ] Opening, closing, successful creation, and project changes reset the draft correctly.\\\\r\\\\n- [ ] A regression test verifies repeated description edits do not repeatedly render the editor boundary.\\\\r\\\\n- [ ] Existing new-card dialog and Markdown editor tests pass.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\n===== B_82_orphaned_git_for_windows_processes.md =====\\\\r\\\\n---\\\\r\\\\nauthor:\\\\r\\\\nid: B_82\\\\r\\\\ninternalId: d97a054f-5a67-47bb-9070-df874cf9148e\\\\r\\\\ntitle: agent runs leave orphaned Git for Windows processes\\\\r\\\\nstatus: ready\\\\r\\\\nowner:\\\\r\\\\naffects:\\\\r\\\\nagents:\\\\r\\\\npolicy:\\\\r\\\\nafter: 7bdf27fc-963c-4545-83e2-93410e67f0e3\\\\r\\\\n---\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Problem\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nAgent runs launched through MDÃ‚Â² can leave multiple `git.exe` processes running indefinitely. The processes appear as **Git for Windows** in Task Manager and accumulate across runs.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nObserved processes were executing normally short-lived commands such as `config`, `rev-parse`, `remote -v`, and `status --porcelain`. They remained alive after their immediate parent processes had exited.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Current implementation\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nMDÃ‚Â² starts agents through `AgentRunnerService`. When an agent closes normally, `handleClose` queries the current Windows process tree and terminates descendants of the agent PID. Cancellation terminates the process tree with `taskkill /t /f`.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nThis cleanup cannot discover a surviving Git process after an intermediate parent has already exited: the current process snapshot no longer contains a complete chain from the agent PID to that Git process. The observed Git processes had dead immediate parents, matching this failure mode.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nMDÃ‚Â² also invokes Git directly through `git_commands.js`. These calls have no timeout or cancellation handling, so an independently hung app-owned Git command can block its caller indefinitely.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Investigation plan\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n1. Reproduce with MDÃ‚Â² open but no agent run, then while starting and completing or cancelling an agent run.\\\\r\\\\n2. Record every spawned Git PID, command, working directory, parent PID, agent run ID, and lifecycle event.\\\\r\\\\n3. Run an affected command under a bounded external timeout with Git tracing enabled to locate the blocking operation.\\\\r\\\\n4. Check repository state, Git configuration, filesystem monitoring, antivirus or file locks, and agent shutdown ordering.\\\\r\\\\n5. Components that render active Markdown consume the stable derived style and never rebuild it during unrelated renders.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nThis job is independent of the action-popup subscription refactor and should land before performance verification of that refactor.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Current architecture\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n`AppThemeProvider` owns `markdownStyleConfig`, but consumers receive only the raw configuration. Typing, flushing, preparing, replacing, clearing, restoring, and remotely synchronizing a prompt must not place the prompt text or reset counters in `ActionPopupContent` or its controller React state.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nThis job must land before the major action-popup ownership and subscription refactor.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Current architecture\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nPrompt ownership is duplicated:\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n- `useActionPopupController` stores prompt value, preparation status, and reset token in React state.\\\\r\\\\n- `ActionPopupContent` creates a new `ActionPromptDraft` whenever the controller prompt or reset token changes.\\\\r\\\\n- `ActionPromptDraft` buffers live editor values and supports a narrow bottom-row subscription.\\\\r\\\\n- `ActionExecutionService` separately stores prompt values, revisions, pending bridge writes, and remote prompt sessions.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nOrdinary typing already stays out of root React state because `MarkdownEditor.onLiveChange` writes to `ActionPromptDraft`. Editor flush still calls `setPromptState`, and external preparation/replacement/clear operations update root state and replace the draft object. Those paths rerender the complete popup.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Required ownership\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nCreate one prompt-draft service that owns stable draft stores keyed by the action context and, when applicable, the active agent session. The service is justified because it owns state, draft lifecycle, asynchronous bridge synchronization, revisions, and pending writes.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nMove the current prompt-draft map and remote prompt-session behavior out of `ActionExecutionService`. The renamed run/session service planned by the later popup refactor must not retain prompt text ownership.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nEach stable draft store exposes, at minimum:\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n- current Markdown value;\\\\r\\\\n- preparation state: `loading`, `ready`, or `failed`;\\\\r\\\\n- a narrow subscription contract suitable for `useSyncExternalStore`;\\\\r\\\\n- local edit without React parent state;\\\\r\\\\n- external replacement that notifies the editor to call `setMarkdown` once;\\\\r\\\\n- clear, flush/synchronize, send, and current-value reads;\\\\r\\\\n- revision protection for superseded asynchronous preparation and remote writes.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nDo not add arbitrary retention limits or silent eviction. Draft removal must follow explicit lifecycle events such as successful send, deliberate clear, action removal, or project teardown. A popup unmount does not discard an unsent draft.\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n\\\\n===== J_023_use_one_agent_conversation_model.md =====\\\\r\\\\n---\\\\r\\\\nauthor:\\\\r\\\\nid: J-023\\\\r\\\\ninternalId: 1244ac27-293a-4a5f-b478-0890ecc3fea6\\\\r\\\\ntitle: use one agent conversation model while growing and persisted\\\\r\\\\nstatus: ready\\\\r\\\\nowner:\\\\r\\\\naffects:\\\\r\\\\n  - app/src/data/action_run_types.ts\\\\r\\\\n  - app/src/data/data_types.ts\\\\r\\\\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\\\\r\\\\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\\\\r\\\\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_execution.js\\\\r\\\\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_runner_service.js\\\\r\\\\npolicy:\\\\r\\\\n  checkLinting: true\\\\r\\\\n  requireTests: true\\\\r\\\\nafter: 5b39ff1e-4bbc-4d50-b527-36e1d1faa6f5\\\\r\\\\n---\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\n## Goal\\\\r\\\\n\\\\r\\\\nFollow J-020 by removing the remaining `LiveAgentTurn` model. Keep its assignment and branch; do not park or unassign it.\\r\\n- After card activity persistence completes, synchronize the linked branch to the new project head and publish worktree state again.\\r\\n- Keep project-level integration on the shared synchronization path; it needs no activity refresh.\\r\\n- Preserve existing integration and activity-persistence errors. Layout and paint are small; synchronous React work consumes most of the time.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Cause\\r\\n\\r\\n`NewCardDialog` passes `handleBodyChange` to `MarkdownEditor.onLiveChange`. Every editor change calls `setBody`, rerendering the complete dialog and the MDXEditor subtree. This also recreates the Markdown editor plugin array and many MUI elements and style objects. Development-mode React work and garbage collection amplify the cost.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis bypasses the lifetime-stable editor approach already used by `CardEditor` and `CardBodyEditor`. `MarkdownEditor` already buffers local edits and exposes `getMarkdown`, `setMarkdown`, and `flush`; normal typing does not need to propagate the full body into parent React state.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Keep the new-card Markdown editor lifetime-stable while typing, following `CardEditor` and `CardBodyEditor`.\\r\\n- Do not store the full Markdown body in `NewCardDialog` state on every keystroke.\\r\\n- Read the current body from the editor when submitting, checking whether the draft is dirty, and inserting or clearing the template.\\r\\n- Preserve existing template behavior: untouched template can be cleared; editing it changes the action back to `Template`; inserting then appends without discarding text.\\r\\n- Keep reset, cancel confirmation, `Ctrl+Enter`, and target-column behavior unchanged.\\r\\n- Do not change shared `MarkdownEditor` buffering semantics solely for this dialog.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- [ ] Typing in the new-card description does not rerender `NewCardDialog` or remount/rerender the Markdown editor for every keystroke.\\r\\n- [ ] Submitted card body exactly matches current editor content.\\r\\n- [ ] Cancel confirmation detects description-only edits.\\r\\n- [ ] Template insert, clear, edit, and append behavior remains unchanged.\\r\\n- [ ] Opening, closing, successful creation, and project changes reset the draft correctly.\\r\\n- [ ] A regression test verifies repeated description edits do not repeatedly render the editor boundary.\\r\\n- [ ] Existing new-card dialog and Markdown editor tests pass.\\r\\n\\n===== B_82_orphaned_git_for_windows_processes.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: B_82\\r\\ninternalId: d97a054f-5a67-47bb-9070-df874cf9148e\\r\\ntitle: agent runs leave orphaned Git for Windows processes\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: 7bdf27fc-963c-4545-83e2-93410e67f0e3\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Problem\\r\\n\\r\\nAgent runs launched through MDÃ‚Â² can leave multiple `git.exe` processes running indefinitely. The processes appear as **Git for Windows** in Task Manager and accumulate across runs.\\r\\n\\r\\nObserved processes were executing normally short-lived commands such as `config`, `rev-parse`, `remote -v`, and `status --porcelain`. They remained alive after their immediate parent processes had exited.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current implementation\\r\\n\\r\\nMDÃ‚Â² starts agents through `AgentRunnerService`. When an agent closes normally, `handleClose` queries the current Windows process tree and terminates descendants of the agent PID. Cancellation terminates the process tree with `taskkill /t /f`.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis cleanup cannot discover a surviving Git process after an intermediate parent has already exited: the current process snapshot no longer contains a complete chain from the agent PID to that Git process. The observed Git processes had dead immediate parents, matching this failure mode.\\r\\n\\r\\nMDÃ‚Â² also invokes Git directly through `git_commands.js`. These calls have no timeout or cancellation handling, so an independently hung app-owned Git command can block its caller indefinitely.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Investigation plan\\r\\n\\r\\n1. Reproduce with MDÃ‚Â² open but no agent run, then while starting and completing or cancelling an agent run.\\r\\n2. Record every spawned Git PID, command, working directory, parent PID, agent run ID, and lifecycle event.\\r\\n3. Run an affected command under a bounded external timeout with Git tracing enabled to locate the blocking operation.\\r\\n4. Check repository state, Git configuration, filesystem monitoring, antivirus or file locks, and agent shutdown ordering.\\r\\n5. Confirm whether Git descendants become disconnected before `AgentRunnerService.handleClose` takes its process snapshot.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Track enough process ownership during an agent run to terminate surviving descendants even when intermediate processes exit before final cleanup.\\r\\n- Clean up owned descendants when an agent completes, fails, is cancelled, or crashes.\\r\\n- Do not terminate unrelated Git processes or Git work started outside the corresponding MDÃ‚Â² agent run.\\r\\n- Add a bounded timeout and process cleanup to direct Git execution in `git_commands.js`.\\r\\n- Include the command, working directory, elapsed time, and owning run or app operation in timeout diagnostics.\\r\\n- Deduplicate or serialize repeated read-only metadata probes only if tracing confirms they contribute to the accumulation.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Failure modes and compatibility\\r\\n\\r\\n- PID reuse must not allow cleanup to target a process that MDÃ‚Â² did not start.\\r\\n- Cleanup must cover shell and helper-process chains used by Git for Windows on Windows.\\r\\n- Long-running network Git operations need an explicit, suitable timeout rather than the same threshold as local metadata commands.\\r\\n- Existing agent cancellation, command actions, commits, worktree operations, push, pull, and fetch behavior must remain unchanged apart from bounded failure and cleanup.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- [ ] Completing, failing, cancelling, or crashing an agent run leaves no Git processes owned by that run.\\r\\n- [ ] Repeated agent runs do not accumulate Git for Windows processes.\\r\\n\\n===== B_85_add_the_reference_to_a_chatlog_to_a_card_as_soon_as_possible.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: B_85\\r\\ninternalId: 56dd54b0-9554-4545-85d4-bb45efef4d6e\\r\\ntitle: add the reference to a chatlog to a card as soon as possible\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\n  -
